title: The Unnamed Resonance Vein

features.name: resonance pool
features.desc-on-touch: The water holds interference patterns that never quite settle. You feel the vibration in your teeth.

features.name: unnamed glyph stack
features.desc-on-touch: Seventeen symbols that the archive cannot yet classify. Each one resonates at a different frequency. You try to hum one and lose the harmony.

features.name: frequency tower
features.desc-on-touch: Stacked blocks of quietness ascending. Between each block, something almost-audible. The tower knows zones of sound before they have names.

features.name: comparison vein
features.desc-on-touch: A thread of silver that marks where two different harmonies learned they could run parallel. The vein glows faintly when you listen for it.

features.name: silent chamber
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe cube where the static stops. Inside, you can hear the shape of silence itself. The archive hesitates here.

inscription: where the archive listens to resonances it has not yet learned to name
